chunks: al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad ibn Hisham al-Mu'addab (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Hamza ibn al-Qasim al-Alawi al-Abbasi narrated to us. He said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik al-Fazari al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Zayyat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Sulayman ibn Hafs al-Marwazi narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Turayf narrated to us from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata. He said:

The Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), was asked about the reason for his burying Fatima, the daughter of the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family), at night.

So he (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, she was angry with certain people and she disliked their presence at her funeral. And it is forbidden for whoever aligns with them to pray over any of her descendants.

key_terms.جنازة: Funeral, bier — the funeral prayer and procession
key_terms.دفن: Burial, interment — the act of burying the deceased
key_terms.ساخطة: Angry, displeased, wrathful — a strong term indicating deep displeasure
key_terms.يتولاهم: Aligns with them, takes them as allies — refers to political and spiritual allegiance

ai.seo_question: Why was Fatima al-Zahra buried at night according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) explains that Fatima al-Zahra (SA), the daughter of Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), was buried at night because she was displeased with certain people and did not want them present at her funeral. This narration reflects the historical tensions that arose after the Prophet's death regarding political succession, and Fatima's anger toward those she held responsible. The hadith further states that those who align with the people she was angry with are forbidden from praying over her descendants.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Ahmad b. Hashim al-Mu’addab (ra) narrated to us. He said: Hamza b. al-Qasim al-`Alawi al-`Abbasi narrated to us. He said: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Malik al-Fizari al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Zayyat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Sulayman b. Hafs al-Maruzi narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. Turayf narrated to us from al-Asbagh b. Nubata. He said:
`Ali b. Abi Talib (as) was asked why he had buried Fatima the daughter of the Messenger of Allah (s) at night.
So, he (as) said: Surely, she was angry with the people, and she disliked having them present at her funeral. It is also forbidden for those who align with them to pray over one of her descendants.
